newsitem.title: UK: RESEARCH ALERT - CU cut at Laing.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - CU cut at Laing.

text.p: Composite insurer Commercial Union Plc was cut to "hold" from "buy" at Credit Lyonnais Laing and estimates for 1996 pretax profit were lowered at the brokerage, mainly to reflect the strength of sterling, traders said.
The stock was down 1/2p at 643 by 1040 GMT in slim trading of 70,267 shares.
Traders pointed out however that CU remains Laing's preferred composite insurer.

Analysts at the brokerage lowered their 1996 pre-tax profit forecast to 446 million stg from 490 million, mostly to reflect the impact of sterling strength on the two thirds of its profits coming from outside the UK.
Laing also expects a decline in CU's life insurance profits, traders said.
